title: The Keeper's Log
text: Mara found the lighthouse keeper's logbook in a tide pool, pages swollen with salt. The last entry, dated the night of the wreck, read only: 'The light was on. They did not turn.' She climbed the stairs that evening, lit the lamp, and waited to see who would come.

title: Last Delivery
text: The delivery robot had one package left and no address. It rolled through the empty mall for three days, asking every mannequin for directions. On the fourth day a janitor opened the box, found a birthday cake, and sang to the robot. It finally marked the delivery complete.

title: Seeds
text: Grandpa labeled every seed packet with the year he collected it, going back to 1961. After the funeral, Lena planted the oldest ones in a cracked clay pot. Nothing happened for weeks. Then, one morning, a single green shoot appeared, bent slightly, as if it were leaning toward someone.
